chat.t: Hello, Savior.
Thank you so much for today.
Thanks to you, I was able to reflect on myself.
I'll definitely contact you again soon.
It's not much, but I'll prepare a little something in return.
I'll look forward to seeing you then.

o: Sure
Why on earth am I your savior though?
Hey
Hey.

lines.t: Humanitas Stadium Entrance
Sigh, why are there so many people?
ChRiss, was it... She definitely is a super popular model.
What should I do...
S-Sorry! Let me through for a second!
Oh my gosh!Gym Uniform Girl B
*Ahem!*Gym Uniform Girl A
Nnngh...!
Let me through!!
Ugh! I-I need to get through...
Screw it.
Whoa! ChRiss is walking by over there!!!!
Autograph—no, we have to take a picture together!!!
Where, where!!!?Gym Uniform Girl A
Kyaaa! ChRiss, please step on me!!!Gym Uniform Girl B
No, not this way, over there—
Gwaaaah!!!!!
Gasp!! U-Um... are you okay...?
No, I'm not. I feel like I just got hit by a truck, so call an ambulance.
People who actually get hit can't say anything, though...?
How do you even know that?!
Phew... It seems you're okay after all.
Heheh... Still, thank you. You were trying to help me, right?
Once again... I ended up being helped by my savior.
Savior?
Me? Why on earth am I your savior?
More importantly, who were you again? I don't remember.
Ah, now that you mention it, I haven't even introduced myself yet.
I'm Jennie. Nice to meet you!
It's not much of a return gift, but... I'll give you a free drink on the house later!
A drink?
Yes. I'm working a part-time job as a drink vendor here.
You know, those people who walk around the stadium with a big tank on their backs? It's like that.
Anyway! Just let me know your seat number, and I'll come find you later with that free drink!
I'm not actually here to watch the race.
Huh...? Then why...
There's something I must do.
Something I'll regret forever if I don't do it now.
I-I see...
You helped me even though you had such an important task.
...As expected, you truly are amazing, Savior.
Seriously, why on earth am I your savior?
I don't have a single memory of it.
...I don't think I can tell you just yet, hehe.
Once I become someone my savior can be proud of... I'll definitely tell you then.
Anyway! Keeping my savior held up like this would be a nuisance.
Please go do what you must do, Savior.
I'll go do what I have to do as well.
Ah, I'll contact you again later. I'll make sure to repay this debt.
(...What on earth is she talking about?)
Well, sure. Make sure to repay me handsomely.
Have a safe trip then. I wish you good luck.
Humanitas Stadium
Sigh, I managed to get in somehow...
When did the crowd grow this big again? I'm screwed.
Please let me through!!!
...I give up. I don't want to get trampled twice in one day.
My luxurious dinner date ticket...

chat.t: Hello, Savior.
Thank you so much for what happened at the stadium last time.
If it's alright, I'd like to repay you. Are you free tomorrow?
And I'm really sorry, but...
There's also something I wanted to ask of you...

o: A favor?

chat.t: 😭... I'm sorry.
You're the only one I can talk to about this, Savior...
It's not much in return, but...
Jennie shared her location.
I booked a restaurant that's rumored to be quite good.
I know this might not be enough, but...

o: Hmm.
I'm a busy man, you know.
I'll go, but if you start annoying me, I'm leaving immediately.

chat.t: Ah, yes!!
Thank you so much 😭!!

lines.t: A restaurant somewhere in Humanitas
Ah, over here!
Hello, Savior. How have you been?
Isn't this place super famous? I heard it's incredibly expensive.
Since it's to repay you, I went all out, hehe.
And because I have a favor to ask...
But this might be a bit of a sudden question...
By any chance, do you know my boss?
Your boss?
Ah. She's the CEO of a courier company called <Lucky Truck>, and her name is Charlotte.
Actually, I'm a receptionist for <Lucky Truck>.
Right now, I'm taking care of other business as a combined vacation and business trip...
Let's go with that for now.
Let's say no for now.
F-For now...?
More importantly, what's this favor you wanted to ask?
Ah, right.
Could you take a look at this first?
Jennie held out something.
<bouten>The 22nd Humanitas Grand Prix Racing Qualifiers</bouten>? What is this?
Do you remember the stadium where we met before?
They just released the schedule for the next racing tournament there.
Usually, they hold qualifiers in various regions to select participants for the main tournament...
Anyone can sign up for the qualifiers, so I'm thinking of entering!
You don't look like the type to enjoy this kind of thing.
Actually, I've always loved driving...
But this is the first time I'm ever entering a racing tournament.
And that's all thanks to the courage I got from your words, Savior... hehe.
Ah, anyway! Working at the stadium was also, originally because I was satisfied just watching...
Hehe, this time, I'm planning to actually compete in the tournament myself!
So the favor is...
Yes... well, actually, there's a new rule for these qualifiers...
Here, 'Qualifiers must be entered as a <bouten>team of two</bouten>.' This part right here.
In other words, I can't even apply on my own...
And I don't really have anyone around to ask for something like this...
That's when I thought of you, Savior...!
But you could just enter this with your boss.
My boss is currently way too busy with work, so she can't...
But asking me is fine?
B-Because you're my savior...?
Who is your savior? Who even are you?
W-Wait a minute! P-Please just hear me out first...!!
A-Anyway! We get prize money just for making it to the main tournament, you know?
I'll give you all of the prize money! I'll handle all the other annoying chores too!
Just enter with me!!
...Okay, I get your passion, but...
What's the reason you want to enter so badly anyway?
I-I'll tell you next time. I-I'm too embarrassed...
What on earth happened between you and me...
...I-I just want to repay the kindness you showed me, Savior...
T-This much I can tell you!
A-And...! If you look here, the prize money is quite...
Oh, this is...
You just have to sit in the passenger seat, Savior!
I'll make sure to never bother you.
Please just sign here...
Hmm... It's a bit suspicious how she keeps hiding it...
Well, I'm sure she has her reasons!
I definitely didn't sign this for the money.
Wow...!! Thank you so much, Savior!!!
We're done, right? Let's go get some food now.
Heheh, yes! Please order as much as you want!!
Excuse me! We're ready to order here!
After that, I listened to her explain the racing tournament for quite a while...
Check, please!
...Pardon? Is i-it really that much...??
M-My allowance for this month is... *whimper*...
I returned home after enjoying a feast for the first time in a long while.

chat.t: Hello, Savior. Have you been doing well?
I'm messaging you because I'm planning to practice for the qualifiers soon.
Just let me know what day works best for you, and I'll book it accordingly.

o: Practice? Do I have to do that too?

chat.t: Ah, it's not like you actually have to do anything, Savior.
It's just that I need you to actually come to the arena with me...

o: Sigh... I told you, I'm a busy man.

chat.t: TT But they said you can only sign up if you're in a team of two, even when just practicing at the official arena.
And I also thought it would be great to have someone by my side to give me an objective evaluation...
I won't contact you like this very often, so please do me this favor TT

o: Whew, just this once.

chat.t: Haha, thank you!

o: Oh, and about that restaurant we went to before.
How about we go there again after practice?

chat.t: Ah.
Um.
I'll try my best, haha...
There was a minor incident today, but...
I still had a wonderful time.
Thank you so much, Savior, haha!
I'll get in touch again for the next practice!

o: You don't really need me there, do you?
You seemed to do just fine on your own earlier.

chat.t: Aw, you flatter me, haha.
It's all because you were right there by my side, Savior.
I'm always indebted to you.
I don't have anything to repay you with yet, but...
If you ever need me, just call and I'll come help right away!
Thank you so much for today! See you next time, haha!

o: Sure. Go a bit easier on the gas next time.
I'd rather not end up on the evening news.

chat.t: Huh? The news?
What do you mean by that?
Savior??

lines.t:
A few days later, I headed to the agreed-upon location
to accompany Jennie for her practice.
Humanitas Stadium
Hello, Savior!
I'll be in your care today!
I just have to sit tight and do nothing, right?
Yes, you don't have to worry about a thing, Savior...
Just get in the <bouten>truck</bouten> with me and watch from the passenger seat!
Get in a truck?
In a racing tournament?
Huh? Oh, yes... That's right. Participants are free to choose any vehicle type.
There are trucks, cars, kick scooters... Anyway, there's a huge variety!
A racing tournament where trucks, cars, and kick scooters compete together?
Hehe, that's right.
So the key is how you leverage the advantages of your vehicle type!
In the case of a truck, its large size gives it an advantage in blocking other competitors!
This town is so screwed up that even its racing tournaments have a screw loose.
Mmh... Well, since we're practicing today with the exact same vehicle used in the tournament...
You don't have to worry, it won't feel much different from how it'll be on the actual day of the qualifiers!
It's not like I was worried about that.
...And trucks are the absolute best, no matter what anyone says.
That's why I resolved to become the best driver of the best truck.
This is what I must do, hehehe...
Well, okay then.
Anyway, I'm sure you know this stuff better than I do.
Hehe, just leave it to me!
Then Savior, I'll be in your care today!
Now, Savior! Get in quick!
This is safe, right?
Oh, of course!
Now, getting ready to start...
...Huh?
Just then, a vehicle charged straight at us from the front!
And it screeched to a halt right in front of us, barely missing...
Savior, are you okay!!?
No, I am not okay. I need to get out. I'm quitting this crazy racing game.
W-Wait a minute! Let's assess the situation first!
L-Look over there! Someone's getting out!
Those people are definitely...
Kehehe! I can't believe you guys are participating too!Gym Uniform Girl A
Kehehe! Look who we have here!Gym Uniform Girl B
You guys...! The ones who refused to get out of the way back then...!
Kehehe! This is no place for greenhorns like you!Gym Uniform Girl A
Kehehe! Yeah, get lost already!Gym Uniform Girl B
*Grip—!*
I'll kill them.
What the? Who are you?
You.
Hold on tight.
Hey, hey. You're not going to... right?
Aaargh!
Aaaaargh!!Gym Uniform Girl A
Aaaaaaaaargh!!!Gym Uniform Girl B
...U-Uh, oh?
What on earth just happened...?
I was definitely in the truck... just a moment ago...
What a convenient gimmick...
Huh...? A-Are you talking about me?
You jerk! I can't believe you actually tried to ram us with your vehicle...!Gym Uniform Girl A
Oh, you want to go?! Bring it on!!Gym Uniform Girl B
W-What?!
What do you mean, "W-What?!"
Hurry up and grab your weapon.
Ah...! Y-Yes, sir!
Urgh! Just you wait!Gym Uniform Girl A
We're going to stalk you and keep getting in your way!Gym Uniform Girl A
Whew, we're in trouble.
It seems we've made them quite angry... What should we do?
Well, if they keep bothering you, just run them over with the truck again. You said it's great for eliminating competitors.
Still, that was impressive. To think you'd ram them without a single moment of hesitation.
Whaaat!? I-I did that?!
Save your excuses for the police station.
U-Ugh...
It's true that I have no memory of when I was driving, but...
...Still, wouldn't this be excused as part of the tournament practice...?
Ramming someone with a truck?
Yes... As far as I know, it's not even that unusual of a strategy...
Since you don't seem used to these kinds of races, Savior, let me explain a bit more...
For example, during the last finals, the winner was decided by a foot race because there were no vehicles left.
Both racers used a strategy of planting <bouten>bombs</bouten> on each other's vehicles.
Actually, this strategy originated in the finals before that one—
Why even call it a racing tournament at that point? What is this, KartR...?
Mmh... But still...
Getting behind the wheel is just so much fun...!
It really clears my head, hehe.
So Savior, I'd love it if you joined me next time too!
Next time?? Driving like that and you want a next time??? Are you trying to kill me?
Some savior I am, you're returning the favor with a death sentence. Good grief.
N-No way!! I-I will absolutely protect you, Savior, so please trust me!!
Then tell me.
Huh? T-Tell you what?
The reason why I'm your savior. I can't stand the suspense anymore.
Urgh...
A-Actually... it's not a big deal, but...
One time, while I was driving...
A major problem came up...
And I was at risk of never being able to drive again...
Stop right there. Are you going to keep doing this? Do you enjoy keeping me on tenterhooks? You cold-blooded woman.
N-No, I mean... I-It's just that...!
Because of... all those things you did after falling naked from the sky, Savior!
I was able to drive freely without any worries...!!
Since it doesn't just involve me, I can't go into detail... but I'm truly grateful...
S-See, I told you... I-It's really no big deal...
Then you should've just said so right away...
Sigh, whatever. Just buy me dinner.
Ah...! S-Shall I?
Let's go to that restaurant we went to before.
Yes! ...Wait? Ah, um... T-That place...?
M-My allowance for this month is s-so...
